query.description: DKAN datastore query on one Open Payments dataset (payments by program year, or a summary table).

dataset.desc: catalog alias (general_2024, state_totals) or dataset id (UUID)

index.desc: distribution index; 0 = the dataset's CSV (each dataset has one, checked 2026-10)

where.desc: equality filters {column: value}; a list value means IN (recipient_state, program_year, covered_recipient_npi)

conditions.desc: list of {property, value, operator}; operators = <> < <= > >= LIKE IN 'NOT IN' BETWEEN CONTAINS 'STARTS WITH'; LIKE uses % and is case-insensitive

sort.desc: column or -column (descending), or a list; slow on the payment files

columns.desc: list of columns to return (default all, about 90 in the payment files)
